# Migration test fixtures

These independently owned fixtures use fabricated Event and Actor requirements.
Each case supplies one migration record. The base requirements contain three
closed IDs and two open IDs. The model includes declared and positional constraint
references, including both positions under the actor relation.

Cases vary one boundary at a time: digest drift, missing or empty evidence,
unpinned artifacts, missing or repeated requirements, unknown IDs, unfinished
history rows, incorrect element references, unknown fields, empty landing lists,
closed-flag mismatch, hostile JSON constants, path escapes and ordering.
The multi-violation cases preserve more than one refusal branch.

The split answer file supplies expected outcomes and exact diagnostic sets.
Large hostile inputs are generated by the test harness to check byte and
artifact limits without committing large payloads.
